text:
carla: deploy-bot reported staging promote failed, blocking release. artifact upload step errored out during promotion to canary. stacktrace attached by deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: CI job `promote-staging->canary` failed: artifact-upload: HTTP 500 from artifact-store (shard lease expired). Retries exhausted.

carla: here's the relevant log snippet:
```
Uploading artifact: redwood-api:2026.11.3 -> s3://redwood-artifacts/canary/
ERROR: PUT /artifact failed: 500 InternalServerError
cause: cache-lease: shard-42 lease not found (expired)
attempt=3, backoff=8s
```

ben: ugh. this is the cache/lease service again? last week we saw similar but it recovered. any sign of broader outage?

alice: checked infra metrics: artifact-store node pool shows increased GC and a bunch of `LeaseAcquire` timeouts for shard-42 between 14:03-14:12 UTC. No other shards impacted.

carla: can we unblock the release by promoting the previous image tag (2026.11.2) while we fix the artifact-store? we need the change window at 16:00.

dave: +1 for promote previous. but note the new image includes a critical routing fix. if we roll back, downstream teams need to be warned.

ben: option A: rollback to 2026.11.2 canary now, run quick smoke, proceed with release notes update. option B: hold canary until artifact-store rebooted (+ manual intervention), could be 30-90m.

alice: remediation plan: 1) restart artifact-store shard-42 process (I can do now) 2) run dedicated upload test for redwood-api artifact 3) if successful, re-run promote job. If restart fails, fallback to promote previous tag.

carla: alice, please try restart now. ben, can you prepare the promote-for-2026.11.2 PR and release-note blurb just in case? include known regression note and link to issue.

ben: on it. branching `release/promote-2026.11.2-canary`, will add changelog line and manual verification steps. cc @dave for QA signoff.

deploy-bot: action required: manual resume for pipeline `promote-staging->canary` is paused. use `/deploy resume promote-staging->canary` after artifact-store healthy.

alice: restarted shard-42 process, tail shows leases re-acquired. running single-file upload test:
```
curl -X PUT https://artifact-store.internal/upload -F file=@redwood-api-2026.11.3.tar.gz
=> 200 OK
```

carla: great. can we retry promote job or do we prefer new promote from CI?

dave: safer to re-run CI promote so we get same pipeline validations. will re-queue after ben's PR prepared.

ben: PR ready, manual promote queued. once CI passes, I'll post verification checklist and add a short release note: "Canary: promote 2026.11.3 delayed due to artifact-store lease expiry; promotion retried after shard restart. No functional regressions observed in smoke."

carla: thanks team. if any failures reappear, we'll abort and promote 2026.11.2. tagging this thread for postmortem: artefact-store lease TTL and auto-restart heuristics.

alice: noted — will capture metrics and open an incident issue with timeline and proposed fix (increase lease renewal frequency + alerting on LeaseAcquire latency).

ben: QA smoke passed. CI promote completed. canary is live. closing hold on change window at 15:10 UTC.

dave: marked in release notes. will add rollback instructions to runbook in case of late issues.

carla: :thumbsup: moving to monitor for 1h then finalize release notes and ship. thanks everyone.
